title: Event envelope
description: Master Spec v4.0 Section 97.3 line 8931: every event carries the same envelope, and an event missing any envelope field is rejected at write time. Nine fields, from the line-8934 example. One file per event; never a concurrent append to a shared period file (line 8929).

event_schema_version.description: Section 97.3 line 8935: stated on every event written; absent reads as 1.

event_type.description: Section 97.3 line 8937: from the closed enum; never free text.

actor.description: Section 97.3 line 8940: the registry identity that acted, human or machine. D88 line 10181: an identity, never a display name.

subject_ref.description: Section 97.3 line 8942: the record this event is about, as a records-repository path.

payload.description: Section 97.3 line 8943: per-type fields, declared with the type in metrics/taxonomy/event-types.yaml. Open by design: the closed shape is the envelope, and the payload keys are constrained per event_type by tools/records/validate-schemas.sh --events.
